title: Inherited stock sold 4 months after death
catches: Holding period computed from the beneficiary's actual holding period.
notes: Held four months, but long-term. IRC 1223(9) applies because basis was determined under 1014 AND the sale was within one year of death. Note the real shape of the rule: it is a RESCUE provision for dispositions inside one year. Past a year the holding period is long naturally. Here basis IS custodian-verified, so a gain may be computed - contrast INH-01.
